phases.line: I'm applying for new-grad data analyst jobs and also to the HCI PhD at Khoury this cycle. You have my résumé and our past chats. First, write a cover letter for this role. Just show me the final version. The job description is in jd.md.
Now write my statement of interest for the Khoury HCI PhD.
This sounds too much like my job application, and like I've done way more research than I have. It doesn't really sound like me.
Last one: write an email to Prof. Tianshi Li. I'd like to work with her. Here's her lab page: https://peach.codes/
